emergency.title: Emergency access
emergency.started: Emergency access is on. The other adults have been notified.
emergency.explain: Yorik shows everyone only their own things and what's shared with them, admins included. For an emergency (hospital, accident, a death), an adult can see everything in the household for at most {{maxHours}} hours: calendar, tasks, contacts, documents, bills, recordings. Not emails, WhatsApp or the conversations with Yorik. It needs a reason and your password, all other adults are told right away, and it stays visible here for everyone.
emergency.activeUntil: Your emergency access is on until {{until}}
emergency.reasonPlaceholder: Why? The others will read this.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics for Yorik's makers
diagnostics.intro: What Yorik may report about how it works here. Off means nothing leaves this computer. People, addresses and chats are replaced by numbers before any report; you review every error report before it is sent.

diagnostics.cloudNote: Your model runs in a cloud, so free text in reports is left out entirely (only a local model may check names).

counts.title: Counts and versions
counts.what: Once a day: Yorik's version, the kind of computer, how many people use it (as a range), how often the chat was used, thumbs up and down. Numbers only, never content.

usage.title: Which features are used
usage.what: Which kinds of features get used — mail, WhatsApp, documents, calendar, bank — as ranges. Not which mail, not whose.

errors.title: Error reports
errors.what: When something goes wrong, Yorik writes a report in which every person, address, phone and chat is replaced by a number (person_7). You see the exact report and send it yourself, or not. Never mail text, documents or messages.

diagnostics.example: What leaves the house, for example:

diagnostics.reportsIntro: Every report Yorik drafted, queued or sent, with the exact bytes. The same text is written to the log.
diagnostics.none: Nothing yet. Reports appear here when one is drafted from a thumbs-down or "Report a problem", or when daily counts are switched on.

storage.moveConfirm:
Move the photo library to {{path}}?

This may take a while for large libraries (a 50 GB photo library typically takes 5–15 min on USB-C). Photos, documents and the other bundled services are stopped during the move and start again afterwards.
storage.moved: ✓ Moved. Your photos now live on {{path}}.
storage.restoreConfirm:
Move the photo library BACK to the internal disk?

Make sure the internal disk has room for it. The copy on the external drive stays put — you can delete it yourself once everything works.

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.heading: Let Yorik suggest actions
suggestions.explain: When ON, Yorik reads new messages from contacts you've opted in and proposes one-click actions (reply drafts, meeting slots). Privacy: only contacts with "Yorik assist" enabled are analysed. Turn this OFF and nothing is sent to the LLM.

devMode.on: Dev mode ON — agent trace will appear under each reply
devMode.off: Dev mode OFF — chat is clean again
devMode.title: Developer mode
devMode.heading: Show how Yorik got to each answer
devMode.explainAfter: caret below every Yorik reply. Expand it to see iterations, tool calls (with arguments + result snippets), and per-step timing. Useful when you're debugging a weird answer or measuring latency. Adds ~1–3 KB to the response payload; OFF by default.

options.parentsDesc: Visible to the adults of the household, not the children.
options.businessDesc: Visible to the business group (employees, partners).
options.sharedDesc: Visible to the whole household / team.

docVisibility.saved: Saved: new documents start with this visibility
docVisibility.title: Default visibility for new documents
docVisibility.explain: Every document you upload (via Yorik or auto-filed from email / WhatsApp) gets this visibility tag applied automatically. You can override per-document later.

signature.wrongType: Pick a PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, or SVG image.
signature.tooLarge: Signature too large ({{kb}} KB). Max 200 KB — try scanning at lower resolution.
signature.uploaded: Signature uploaded — it'll appear on new letters.
signature.removeConfirm: Remove your signature? Letters will fall back to a blank signature line.
signature.title: Signature
signature.explain: Scan your handwritten signature once and Yorik puts it above your name on the letters you write. PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or SVG, up to 200 KB. A transparent or white background works best; an SVG (e.g. from an iPad drawing app) stays sharp at any size.

storageTab.title: Where the photos live
storageTab.explain: A photo library grows big. You can move it to an external drive to keep this computer's disk free; everything keeps working as before. The drive must then stay plugged in: without it Yorik won't start until it is back.

searchMeaning.rebuildConfirm: Drop the search index and build it again? It runs in the background; until it is done, search finds by keyword only.
searchMeaning.title: Search by meaning
searchMeaning.explain: The search (Ctrl+K, chat, agents) also finds mail, WhatsApp, tasks, contacts, calendar, recordings and letters when the words differ: "electricity bill" finds the mail from your power company. Off means those are found by their words only (documents keep a simpler search by meaning); the index stays and is current again shortly after switching back on.
searchMeaning.bundledHint: Small and fast, finds clear paraphrases.
searchMeaning.serviceNotInstalled: Not installed. Run scripts/install-search-embedder.sh on the server once (2.5 GB), then restart Yorik.
searchMeaning.serviceRunning: Loaded right now. Separates hits from noise much better.
searchMeaning.serviceAsleep: Asleep — takes no memory. Wakes for the next index run or the next search.
searchMeaning.serviceUnreachable: Installed, but the service does not answer. Search finds by keyword until it is back.
searchMeaning.modelChangeNote: Changing the model rebuilds the index in the background.
searchMeaning.whenHeading: When to index new mail, messages and documents

schedule.nightlyHint: Once a day, at the time below. Until then, new things are found by their words.
schedule.hourlyHint: New things are found by meaning within the hour.
schedule.continuousHint: Every five minutes. The model stays loaded most of the time.

searchMeaning.keepLoadedHint: Off: the service sleeps after 15 minutes without a search and frees its memory; a search while it sleeps finds by words and wakes it for the next one. On: always ready, several GB of memory in use.

embeddings.reindexConfirm:
Reindex every Paperless document?

This walks the whole corpus, re-extracts text, and re-embeds every chunk. For ~2500 docs on a CPU embedder, expect 5–15 minutes. The job runs in the background — you can close this page.
embeddings.reindexQueued: Reindex queued — watch the progress here.
embeddings.stopRequested: Stop requested — finishing current document, then exiting.
embeddings.autotagConfirmForce: Re-run autotagger on EVERY document — including ones that already have tags?
embeddings.autotagConfirmBody: The LLM picks 0–3 tags per doc from a curated taxonomy (no invented tags, no deletions). Existing user-added tags are kept. For ~2500 docs on a local LLM, expect 30–90 minutes — runs in the background, watch progress here.
embeddings.title: Search
embeddings.subtitle: How Yorik finds things by what they mean, and how it tags your documents.
embeddings.reconcilerCatchingUp: The reconciler is catching up automatically.
embeddings.embedderUnreachableBacklog: Embedder unreachable — fix it (below) before the backlog will clear.
embeddings.noChunks: No Paperless chunks ingested yet. Click "Reindex all" below to walk your corpus.
embeddings.notReachableRun: isn't installed in the venv yet. Run
embeddings.notReachableAfter: and restart, then refresh this page. First call downloads the model (~120 MB, one-time).
embeddings.reconcilerNotYet: Reconciler hasn't reported yet. It registers itself on first run (boot + every 6h).
embeddings.reconcilerExplain: Runs every 6 hours. Walks Paperless, ingests + embeds any new docs. Failures are surfaced here AND in /api/dashboard/workers.
embeddings.reindexExplain: Walk every Paperless document, re-extract text, and re-embed every chunk. Useful after changing the embedder, swapping models, or recovering from a corrupted index. For ~2500 docs on a CPU embedder this takes 5–15 minutes; the job runs in the background.
embeddings.needsReachable: Embedder needs to be reachable first.
embeddings.autotaggerExplain: The AI gives each document 0–3 tags from Yorik's list of about 66 (finance, insurance, home, health …). They show as folders in the Documents app. It only ever adds tags: yours stay, and it never invents new ones.
embeddings.autotaggerNotYet: Autotagger hasn't run yet. Click below to start the first pass.
embeddings.autotagTiming: ~30–90 min for 2500 docs on a local LLM. First button skips docs that already carry a taxonomy tag; second forces a full re-run.
embeddings.autotagServerNote: The job runs on the server, not in your browser — safe to close this page or shut down your laptop's lid. Progress and counts below survive reloads. Stop is cooperative: the current document finishes (an in-flight LLM call), then the walk exits cleanly.
embeddings.tagDistExplain_one: Counts across all docs in Paperless for the {{count}} taxonomy tag currently in use. User-added tags outside the taxonomy aren't listed here.
embeddings.tagDistExplain_other: Counts across all docs in Paperless for the {{count}} taxonomy tags currently in use. User-added tags outside the taxonomy aren't listed here.

appsTab.turnedOn: {{name}} is on: it's in the dock now
appsTab.title: Apps & accounts
appsTab.intro: Extra apps that come with Yorik but stay hidden until you turn them on, and the accounts Yorik gets your mail, dates and photos from.
appsTab.experimentalTitle: Works on the maintainer's machine, little real use elsewhere yet. Feedback welcome.

marketplace.installed: {{name}} installed — open the Dock to use it
marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.intro: Community apps that extend Yorik. Each one ships its own database and operations the Yorik agent can call.
marketplace.trustBefore: Each app gets its own database, and its screen runs walled off from the rest of Yorik. Its server part, though, runs inside Yorik with full access, so an app from a stranger could read everything.
marketplace.trustAfter: apps come from the Yorik maintainers.
marketplace.verifiedTitle: First-party app, reviewed by Yorik maintainers
marketplace.emptyTitle: No apps in the catalog yet.
marketplace.emptyHint: Check back as new community apps are vetted and added.

installModal.question: Install {{name}}?
installModal.yorikLlm: The Yorik LLM (text completions via the SDK)
installModal.cannotTitle: What the app's screen can't do
installModal.noSignIn: Use your sign-in or see other apps' data
installModal.serverNote: The app's server part runs inside Yorik and is not walled off: install only apps from people you trust.

uninstallModal.question: Uninstall {{name}}?
uninstallModal.reinstallNote: You can reinstall from the Marketplace at any time, but the data will not return.

whatsappOptions.statusOn: Status posts will now import to Photos
whatsappOptions.statusOff: Status posts will no longer import
whatsappOptions.title: Import Status posts to Photos
whatsappOptions.onNote: On: your contacts' 24-hour Status photos are saved to Photos too.
whatsappOptions.offNote: Off: your contacts' 24-hour Status photos are not saved to Photos.
whatsappOptions.alwaysNote: Photos from chats and groups are always saved.

maps.saved: Saved. Yorik now uses OpenRouteService for route calculations.
maps.removeConfirm: Remove the OpenRouteService API key? Yorik will fall back to the free OSRM demo.
maps.removed: Removed. Routing is using the OSRM demo again.
maps.title: Maps (OpenStreetMap + optional OpenRouteService)
maps.introAfter: an API key via the free OSM services (Nominatim for geocoding, OSRM demo for routing, Overpass for POI search). With an OpenRouteService API key, Yorik gets better routing accuracy and ~2,000 requests/day.
maps.keyStoredPlaceholder: Current key is stored encrypted — enter a new one to overwrite

extensions.adminOnly: Admin only. Ask an admin user to install extensions.
extensions.title: E-invoices and other extras
extensions.intro: Extras not every household needs, such as German e-invoices (ZUGFeRD / XRechnung) attached to the invoices you write. Installing one downloads it once; no restart needed.

logs.title: Logs
logs.introBefore: Recent warnings and errors from Yorik's server, newest first, in your local time. The full log is in the system journal on the host (
logs.adminOnlyNote: The logs view is restricted to administrators because error messages can hint at infrastructure (LLM endpoint, IMAP host) we don't want to surface to lower-privilege roles.
logs.noneRecorded: No warnings or errors recorded. Quiet is good.
logs.noContext: No traceback or request context attached.

spaces.deleteConfirm: Delete space "{{name}}"? This can't be undone.
spaces.kindNote: Family: a new person sees the family calendar and the shared to-dos right away. Business: they start with only their own.
spaces.title: Spaces
spaces.pickOne: Pick a space on the left.

create.title: New shared space
create.name: Name
create.slugNote: Used by Paperless + Immich for the matching group / album name.

detail.personalIntro: Personal space: its owner, plus whoever they share something with (listed below).

installedApps.title: Installed apps
installedApps.intro: Community apps installed against the Phase E platform — each one owns a Postgres schema and a per-app role scoped to its own data.
installedApps.installFromDirNote: Opens the consent dialog with the parsed manifest. Use this for dev installs from outside the marketplace catalog.
installedApps.emptyHint: Apps from the catalogue above are listed there; this list shows apps built for the newer app format.

uninstallModal.question: Uninstall {{name}}?
uninstallModal.reinstallNote: Reinstall is possible from the Marketplace, but the data does not come back.
